svg.aria-label: Dijkstra's three-way partition of 5 3 5 9 5 1 5 around v = 5. Green: keys less than v, a[lo..lt-1]; amber: keys equal to v, a[lt..i-1]; white: unexamined, a[i..gt]; blue: keys greater than v, a[gt+1..hi]. The ringed cell is a[i]. start v = a[lo] = 5: [5 3 5 9 5 1 5] (lt at 0, i at 1, gt at 6) (a[0] is the pivot: the "= v" region). a[1] = 3 3 < 5: [3 5 5 9 5 1 5] (lt at 1, i at 2, gt at 6) (swap a[lt], a[i]; lt++, i++). a[2] = 5 5 = 5: [3 5 5 9 5 1 5] (lt at 1, i at 3, gt at 6) (i++). a[3] = 9 9 > 5: [3 5 5 5 5 1 9] (lt at 1, i at 3, gt at 5) (swap a[i], a[gt]; gt−−; i stays). a[3] = 5 5 = 5: [3 5 5 5 5 1 9] (lt at 1, i at 4, gt at 5) (i++). a[4] = 5 5 = 5: [3 5 5 5 5 1 9] (lt at 1, i at 5, gt at 5) (i++). a[5] = 1 1 < 5: [3 1 5 5 5 5 9] (lt at 2, i at 6, gt at 5) (swap a[lt], a[i]; lt++, i++; i > gt: the pass is over).
svg.text: a[0] is the pivot: the "= v" region
swap a[i], a[gt]; gt−−; i stays
i > gt: the pass is over
